summary: Black Friday half-day (NYSE closes 1 PM ET): the open is fading the pre-market gap, SPY 722.4 (open 725.9) and QQQ 639.9 (open 645.5), still about +0.8-0.9% on the day; SPY puts outnumber calls 1.7 to 1. Change since the morning run: chips sold off hard in the first 5 minutes with no new headline, so the NVDA and AMD calls failed and are flipped to puts, MU's put hit its first target, and AMZN's call was cut to 45. IBKR data REALTIME.

picks.name: Micron Technology
picks.reason: The gap fade is working: it broke 629.79 and the 622.90 pre-market low, falling from 630.76 to 613 right after the open, and options volume is running about 1.6x a normal pace. Rated 53, not 55, because calls still outnumber puts 1.7 to 1 and IV is at its 13-week high. Losing the 613.03 day low targets the 604.95-601.25 gap fill.

picks.name: Nvidia
picks.reason: Flipped from call: the gap fully filled on 9.8M shares in the first 5 minutes, and the stock is now red on the day while QQQ is still up about 0.9%, with no new headline. Calls still lead puts 1.5 to 1 and IV is in the 97th percentile, so this is under 50. Losing 147.00 (just under the 147.12 day low) targets 143; a reclaim of 149.30 cancels it.

picks.name: Advanced Micro Devices
picks.reason: Flipped from call: it rejected 420 at the open and broke the 413.27 breakdown, following NVDA's gap fill. Options volume is only at a normal pace and IV is in the 97th percentile (13-week), so confidence is modest. A break of 406.03 (Wednesday close) fills the gap and targets 397.7.

picks.name: Amazon
picks.reason: Black Friday kickoff, and calls still outnumber puts 2.3 to 1, but it slipped under the 249.40 pre-market low with the tape. Cut from 54 to 45, with levels moved to the new opening range: it needs to reclaim the 250.47 opening high, and losing 246.56 opens the gap fill.

picks.name: Broadcom
picks.reason: Laggard after the reported Google TPU order cut, but it is holding up better than NVDA and AMD in the opening fade (304.75-308.49 range), and options volume is light (about 0.8x pace, calls ahead). Trimmed to 45. Losing 302.25 targets the 300.86 gap fill. Earnings are on Dec 9.

picks.name: Walmart
picks.reason: Flat in a tight 131.68-132.32 range with no catalyst. The rotation-out thesis is weaker now that the tech gap is fading (defensives may catch a bid), so trimmed to 40. A break of the 131.00 pre-market low still targets 129.9.
